_comment: EXP-B fixed model for the tokenizer-vs-tokenizer comparison (D-038 hand-off). Deliberately small: the goal is to compare tokenizers under identical conditions on CPU, not to build a strong model. Every cell (every tokenizer, every seed) must use this exact model; only data.path, data.seed, train.seed, train.out_dir and train.max_steps vary per run. The step budget default (1000) may be revised ONCE, after the PC timing smoke, and the same budget must be used for all cells.
